papers.text: A study of park noise. So far: 90 % band, 10 % ducks objecting.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The noise study asks to hear the ducks separately, on a weekday.

papers.text: Put the flower beds behind glass. Then price cards. Then a shop bell.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: A study of the 900 park benches: 3 see a road. The rest, hedge.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The bench study needs a second sitting. Some benches were taken.

papers.text: Hedge each park path. Straighten the paths. Then the coach road.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: Go window-shopping, for the camera. We have wrapped you a window.
papers.subject: vanity

papers.text: The hedge show asks for the flower show's day. Hedges do not wilt.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: Pose at the new coach stop in the rose bed. No coach is due.
papers.subject: buses

papers.text: The anglers have had 312 still evenings. The band would like one.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Tour the provinces with the national pumpkin. Front seat. Wave second.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: The Mill's first ribbon. Uncut. It could open something? No reason.
papers.subject: ribbons

favour.text: About the ribbon: it would like to lead the Sunday concert.

clippings.sign: RIBBON LEADS BAND; BAND FOLLOWS, PUZZLED
clippings.refuse: RIBBON STAYS IN ITS BOX, UNCUT AND UNSURE

papers.text: Mow a kite runway in the park meadow. Ours have nowhere to taxi.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: We will pay to hang COACHES, THIS WAY on your fountain. The Guild's hat must go.
papers.subject: fountains

papers.text: A study: are the park's flower beds straight enough to be beds?
papers.subject: gardens
papers.biggerStudy: The bed study now wants to measure each flower, against a ruler.

papers.text: Every Mill ribbon to read CUT BY THE PRESIDENT. Before you cut it.
papers.subject: ribbons

papers.text: Cufflinks: two small fountains in your shape. A tie pin follows.
papers.subject: fountains

favour.text: About the cufflinks: they would like a seat at the Quiet Competition.

clippings.sign: PRESIDENT'S CUFFLINKS JOIN QUIET COMPETITION; TRICKLE
clippings.refuse: CUFFLINKS KEPT IN A DRAWER, STILL RUNNING

papers.text: The marrows have had the band's front row for years. Move them.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: A study to pick the Ribbon Mill's next shade. So far, 40 beiges.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The shade study wants 40 more beiges. Two of the first matched.

papers.text: Unveil the national pumpkin's arcade plinth. Bow after it does.
papers.subject: vegetable-shows

papers.text: We will pay to judge your lawn's edges. Kites off it, pending.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: A bandstand on the park lake's island. The ducks are in favour.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Lend the League the hedge show lawn. It gets 80 % of the breeze.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: A Ribbon Mill window: RIBBON, BEING MADE. Rosettes can wait.
papers.subject: ribbons

papers.text: A fountain in your shape in all nine provinces. Rodney wants a tenth.
papers.subject: fountains

papers.text: Fly the motto on a kite: PROUDLY ADEQUATE. It flies about that well.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: Move the spotters' bench. Our hedge now has a bench-shaped gap.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: Your signature printed on every form. Then you need never read one.
papers.subject: paperwork

papers.text: Cut the ribbon on our new notebook. Small scissors have been found.
papers.subject: ribbons

papers.text: We will pay for a kite-free lake. Kites must apply to be reflected.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: A study of where the band should stand. Every spot, the arcade first.
papers.subject: committees
papers.biggerStudy: The standing study asks to try every spot again, sitting down.

papers.text: Turn your fountain to face the arcade. It has seen enough marrows.
papers.subject: fountains

papers.text: Ribbon Mill kite tails: a metre each. Then two. Then the reel.
papers.subject: ribbons

papers.text: Face the music. The band has chosen it, and will point it at you.
papers.subject: bandstands

papers.text: Form 7 of the Republic is for coaches. The Guild files hats on it.
papers.subject: paperwork

papers.text: We will pay to keep the park hedges in good shape. Our shape: a hat.
papers.subject: hedges

papers.text: Feed the ducks at the Quiet Competition, for the camera. Mime the crumbs.
papers.subject: ducks

papers.text: We will pay for a sign: KITES LAND HERE. In the dahlias, mostly.
papers.subject: kites

papers.text: Lakeside benches, facing the water. Backs to the hedge show.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: A study of the kite form. Its one box says NO, in the Committee's hand.
papers.subject: paperwork
papers.biggerStudy: The study asks for a form to add a box. That form has no box either.

papers.text: Growers water from our lake: a can, then a hose, now a pump.
papers.subject: gardens

papers.text: Swap the park railings for hedge, clipped to look like railings.
papers.subject: hedges
